title: MZ Do you know how to implement real-time in a custom menu?

posts.author: fujino
posts.body:
Hello, nice to meet you.
Please forgive any ambiguity due to the use of translations.
Do you know of a plugin that displays the current time of the PC on a custom menu screen?
It uses RPG MAKER MZ.
I am using a plugin called SceneCustomMenu.js from Triacontan in Japan.
I would like to create a custom menu with it and display realtime there.
However, it does not work.
I tried to write a script in common events to call it and display it, but I can't figure out how to make it display in the triacontant plugin.
I would like to know if there is a way or js to display the time on the menu screen, even if it is another plugin.
I would like to display it in hh:mm.
Sorry if this is rude.
I would appreciate it if you could help me.
js described in Common Events:
const now = new Date();
const hours = now.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
const minutes = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
$gameVariables.setValue(6, `${hours}:${minutes}`);

There is the following item in the plugin, where you fill in the `Text:${$item.name}` with what you want to display.
this.drawTextEx(`Text:${$gameVariables.value(6) }`, r.x, r.y, r.width); // any text drawing(with control character conversion)
If $$gameVariables.value(6) is specified, the value is 0.
Is this 0 because the common event is not called?
\V[6] is displayed as \V[6].
Common events have a parallel common event setting, which can be used to call common events in parallel....
Is it possible to call the common event directly in `Text:${$item.name}`? (I'm not sure if my writing style is bad or not, but I get an error:_)

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
The default value of a game variable is 0. Your common event isn't running.
You could try
Code:
`Text:${${new Date().getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0') + ":" + new Date().getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}}`

posts.body: If it's saying it's missing a } just add another one at the end. I tried that expression as is in SRD HUDMaker and it worked for me.
